copy_audit.instructions: Is the copy in `text` shippable on Amazon as written?

criteria.pass: no prohibited or unsupported claim is detectable
criteria.block: an Amazon-prohibited promotional term is present

blocker_escalation.instructions: Does the blocker in `text` interrupt the operator now or ride the next batched report?

criteria.now: a live-lane failure, guardrail breach, or production break
criteria.later: real friction but work can continue on other batches
criteria.never: an idea or nice-to-have belonging in the backlog
